heading: Term
text: This Agreement is effective 1 January 2026 and continues for 24 months, ending 31 December 2027.

heading: Incident Response
text: Vendor shall respond to Critical incidents within 4 hours of notification.

heading: Breach Notification
text: Vendor shall notify Customer of any personal data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware of it.

heading: Access Reviews
text: Vendor shall review privileged access to Customer systems quarterly.

heading: Payment Terms
text: Customer shall pay undisputed invoices within 45 days of the invoice date (Net 45).

heading: Insurance
text: Vendor shall maintain cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 throughout the Term.

heading: Coverage
text: Cyber liability coverage limit: USD 2,000,000 per claim.

heading: Policy Period
text: Policy period: 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026. Coverage ends at expiry unless renewed.

heading: Invoice Details
text: Invoice date: 1 March 2026. Amount due: USD 48,200 for cloud services, February 2026.

heading: Payment Terms
text: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date (Net 30).

heading: Response Times
text:
Response and resolution targets by incident severity are set out in the table below. | Severity | Response time | Resolution target |
|---|---|---|
| Critical | 8 hours | 24 hours |
| High | 12 hours | 48 hours |
| Medium | 2 business days | 5 business days |
